mutants.name: process-wide latch restored (any failure poisons the run)
429 backoff window removed (immediate retry hammers API)
Retry-After ignored (fixed long backoff delays recovery)
per-batch fallback removed (failed batch returns empty)

limitations: Backoff timing is tested with a 2.2s sleep against Retry-After: 1; jitter (<=500ms) is bounded and the window math is declared (cap 30s).
The verifier proves the quality cliff is fixed (batch degrades, run continues), not wall-clock index time; 429 storms still slow indexing by design.
Local-word-vector fallback vectors are real but not asserted for semantic quality here; model-label separation is enforced by engine invariants tested elsewhere.
